stations.title: Ossian
stations.say: How many days has this pass left?

stations.title: Ossian's fingers
stations.text: Counting the days of each month by hand

stations.title: Passenger
stations.say: Right to the day. Thank you.
stations.note: And no boat on a Sunday.

captions: The slip at Lanternquay. Ossian sells season passes, and people ask how long theirs lasts.
Counted on fingers, a pass bought on 31 January runs out on the wrong day.
You make dates, count to them in months and days, and print each day for the timetable.
Now every pass runs out on the right day, and knows how many days it has left.
The printed timetable names its days in English on any computer, and Sunday stays quiet.
